applies_on_use: applies when you use the theme
drift: Not every app uses the same icon theme. Use a theme to bring them back in line.
engine_missing: The icon engine did not run. Check that python3 is installed.
engine_timeout: The icon engine took longer than a minute and was stopped. Try again.
in_use_family: A variant of this theme is in use. Use another theme first.
missing_files: This theme uses files from {name}, which is not installed. Get {name} again from Get more, or remove this theme.
missing_in_use: It is in use, so your icons are broken right now: pick another theme on the left and press Use this theme.
no_files: No .tar or .zip file to install. Open the page to see what it ships.
no_results: Nothing matched. Try a shorter word.
no_themes: No icon themes found. Get one from gnome-look with Get more.
picker_missing: zenity is not installed, so there is no folder picker. Install zenity, or use Get more.
reset_explain: Removes the icon theme this plugin set for GNOME, GTK, Qt and KDE apps and goes back to the system default. Your installed themes stay. This also happens when you remove the plugin.
search_hint: Search gnome-look.org, or press Search to see what is popular.

icon_dirs.description: Also look for icon themes here. ~/.local/share/icons, ~/.icons and $XDG_DATA_DIRS are always searched.
icon_dirs.label: Extra theme folders
